answer_1.quote: We propose the MediaHG model which disentangles the eye-catchy features as additional requirements in sequence-to-sequence training. The model is composed of a headline candidates generator and an eye-catchy headline selector.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 500 cases from the test set and ask three familiar and loyal REDBook users as annotators to score the headlines generated by BART, PEAGASUS, and MediaHG. The human evaluation is based on 3 aspects: sentence fluency, content faithfulness, and contextual eye-catchy requirements.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each headline on fluency, consistency (content faithfulness), and attractiveness on a scale from 1 to 3.
